Growth & demand: Further, the consolidated profit after tax also grew by 35% with a profit of INR70 crores for Q2 and growth of 47% with a profit of INR180 crores in H1 of the current financial y ear.
Price growth is almost 4.9% and the new product growth is 0.8% and overall we have grown by 5.8%.

Having said this, yes, the market is very dynamic and as I said that with the volume growth in negative, as again reported by Pharma rac for the last five months to six months, we have been reworking our strategy because as you know, for growth there are only three components, one is volume, one is price and one is new products.
Margins & costs: Company reported consolidated EBITDA of INR76 crores, growing at 13% for Q2 and EBITDA of INR198 crores, registering growth of 36% for H1 of the current financial year.
The primary drivers of the increased profitability are improved cost of goods sold and relatively low operational expenses during the first half of the current financial year.

Having said that, the quarter two EBITDA margin is also healthy and on a year-to-date basis, if you see, we are almost close to 19%, slightly marginally above 19% on a consolidated basis which we believe as a trend is reflecting all our efforts in terms of margin improvement and the management is quite focused on improving i t.
Capex & expansion: So, those one-off type of expenditures are basically investment in nature.
Having said that, if I have to give s ome range of expenditure, our regular maintenance capex is about INR50 odd crores annually.
The capex for the ne xt 12 to 15 months is in the range of about INR170 odd crores.
Balance sheet & cash: As you all are aware that C ompany maintains a track record of rewarding the shareholder in the most efficient way and with the healthy profitability, the board approved buyback of 31 lakh equity shares of INR1 each at a price of INR500 per share.
The buyback process and payout was concluded during Q2 of the financial year.
You know, they are over leveraged for the US market.
Risks & challenges: We have expanded in the East which was a weak zone for us and I am happy to share in the last 2 years our progress has been pretty good especially in Bihar, Odisha side and now we have entered into West Bengal also.

East and South was slightly a weaker zone for us or rather I can say East was mostly non - operational which we have done now in the last couple of years and we are quite satisfied with the progress what we have made.
They have declined on a Q -o-Q basis largely on account of other expenses and other expenses have remained largel y volatile.
